Data.title: Discrimination Or Harassment Experienced At Work Or During Job Search, Annual
Data.footnote: Data are taken from Ministry of Manpower (MOM)'s Supplementary Survey on Fair Employment Practices. Data are used for SDG 10.3.1/16.b.1 'Proportion of population reporting having personally felt discriminated against or harassed in the previous 12 months on the basis of a ground of discrimination prohibited under international human rights law'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 10.3.1.
